name: How do I choose between a walk-in shower and a tub in a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: When is a walk-in shower the better choice, and when should a tub stay in the design?
mainEntity.text: When is a walk-in shower the better choice, and when should a tub stay in the design?

acceptedAnswer.text: The right choice depends on lifestyle and the home’s long-term goals. Walk-in showers are popular because they save space, feel modern, and are easier to use for many adults. Tubs still matter if the home will be marketed to families, if children will use the bathroom, or if the homeowner values soaking and resale flexibility. In some cases, a compact tub-shower combo is the most practical layout. Homeowners should think about who uses the bathroom now and who may use it later. The decision should be made with real use in mind, not just current trends, because removing a tub can be hard to reverse once the remodel is complete.
acceptedAnswer.description: A walk-in shower is usually better when accessibility, space, and daily convenience matter most. A tub makes more sense when the home needs family use, resale flexibility, or a bathing option. The best choice depends on how the bathroom is actually used.
